Advanced Diabetes Supply (
ADS
) is
a major US supplier specializing in home delivery of medical-grade continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), insulin pumps, and remote patient monitoring gear
. Their catalog features leading prescription CGMs like the Dexcom G7 and Abbott FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus.
Advanced Diabetes Supply
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
Medical grade vs. OTC:
True medical CGMs (Dexcom, FreeStyle Libre) require a prescription and measure interstitial fluid dynamically every 1 to 5 minutes.
Advanced Diabetes Supply role:
ADS
helps manage insurance and Medicare paperwork for home shipments of these clinical systems.
Advanced Diabetes Supply
Smartwatches and Wearables
Wrist display:
Many smartwatches (Apple Watch, Garmin, Samsung Galaxy) act as secondary displays via Bluetooth, streaming data directly from your CGM app.
Healthline
Non-invasive limitation:
Wristwatches claiming to directly measure blood sugar via optical sensors or watchbands are not FDA-approved, lack critical high/low alerts, and do not replace medical CGMs.
YouTube
Type One Talks
Wearable ECG & Sleep Trackers
Heart and recovery metrics:
Consumer wearables track heart rate and sleep stages, which correlate with autonomic nervous system recovery and stress-induced glucose spikes.
National Institutes of Health (NIH) | (.gov)
ECG functions:
Watches with FDA-cleared electrical sensors can spot abnormal heart rhythms (like atrial fibrillation) but do not interface with metabolic glucose data.

Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Data sharing:
Platforms like Dexcom Clarity or LibreView allow clinical teams to review uploaded CGM files remotely using specific medical billing codes.
